scripts.deploy: node -e "console.error('環境を指定してください: npm run deploy:test（テスト） / npm run deploy:prod（本番）');process.exit(1)"
scripts.deploy:test: node infra/scripts/check-branch.js test && npm test && npm run build && npm run deploy:test -w infra
scripts.deploy:prod: node infra/scripts/check-branch.js prod && npm test && npm run build && npm run deploy:prod -w infra
